notes.title: Update for version 0.9.9.0
notes.content:
Hello there!

This version includes the following:

[list]
[*] A new scene called "Catacombs". It's what leads Haruki into the tunnels during his flashback in the Library.
[*] The story has been adjusted slightly for the new scene and Haruki's past.
[*] The detective will show up in the North Shuri Castle Courtyard after your investigation.
[*] Fixed an issue with certain sounds/audio playing with reverb on them unintentionally.
[*] Updated the left/right arrow buttons to rotate Haruki.
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rs6stPyt/2025-08-11-T17-47-00.png[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gjvJyHrt/2025-08-12-T08-33-02.png[/img]

Thanks for playing!

Larry

tags.feature: A new scene called "Catacombs".
Updated the left/right arrow buttons to rotate Haruki.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with certain sounds/audio playing with reverb on them unintentionally.

notes.title: Updates for build 0.9.8.4

Hello there,

This build includes the following:

[list]
[*] A younger Haruki in the flashback.
[*] Fixed the interaction text to display in the bounds of the screen when at the edges.

[*] Updated the song in Keiko's room to use a Taiko 5 created song. Available on Steam!

[/list]

Thanks for playing!

Larry

notes.title: Version 0.9.5 Update
notes.content:
Hello,

This is a significant update with the following major changes:

[list]
[*] Haruki can walk around now.
[*] Interactions work with a single click now.
[*] There are more dark spirits that can put Haruki in a coma.
[*] The game's story is mostly linear now.
[*] The music was completely redone with assistance from Dova Syndrome.
[*] The spirits all look more ethereal.
[*] The narrative was updated.
[*] Many bug fixes.
[/list]

All the best,

Larry

tags.feature: Haruki can walk around now.
Interactions work with a single click now.
There are more dark spirits that can put Haruki in a coma.
The game's music was completely redone with assistance from Dova Syndrome.
The spirits all look more ethereal.

tags.bug: Many bug fixes.
